subcategory_text: Systems/products/services that process data are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-8 (System Component Inventory), PM-5 (System Inventory)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.9 (Inventory of information and other associated assets)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-01 (physical/software inventory) and ID.AM-02 (software platforms inventory)
implementation_examples: Author and maintain a system inventory that lists the systems, products, and services that process personal data, including ownership, classification, and processing context
Tag each inventory entry with the privacy-relevant data categories processed so it can be cross-referenced against the data-element inventory
Refresh the inventory on a defined cadence and on material change to the processing environment
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the inventory of systems/products/services that process personal data exists and is current
Determine whether inventory items identify privacy-relevant attributes (data category, owner, jurisdiction)
Determine whether inventory updates are triggered by changes to the processing environment
Determine whether the inventory is accessible to authorised privacy and security roles
